note: This file contains only module-level configuration preset dictionaries (psiformer, ferminet, excited_states) created via utils.flatten_dict_keys. There are no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. These presets are designed to be applied via config.update_from_flattened_dict().
use_psiformer_preset: update a config with the psiformer network preset using config.update_from_flattened_dict(psiformer)
use_ferminet_preset: update a config with the ferminet network preset using config.update_from_flattened_dict(ferminet)
use_excited_states_preset: update a config with the excited_states optimization preset using config.update_from_flattened_dict(excited_states)
combine_presets: apply multiple presets by calling config.update_from_flattened_dict for each preset dict in sequence
inspect_preset_keys: inspect the flattened keys of a preset dict by printing its contents directly
